description: A PHP source file for handling the creation of requirements in TestLink from MantisBT XML issue reports. It includes functions for importing, processing XML data, and managing file uploads, specifically tailored for integrating Mantis issues into TestLink.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes request arguments and session data, setting default actions and user/test project info.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Prepares the GUI configuration object with import limits, types, and associated requirement specification details.

methods.name: doExecuteImport
methods.description: Handles the import process, uploads the XML file, and calls the parser to convert Mantis issues into requirements.

methods.name: doReqImportFromMantisXML
methods.description: Converts a simple XML object of Mantis issues into requirement items by mapping each issue.

methods.name: getFromMantisIssueSimpleXMLObj
methods.description: Extracts and compiles issue data from the XML object into a structured array for import.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks user permissions for viewing and modifying requirements.
